cards.ex: I'm bringing my significant other to the party tonight.
cards.exUz: Men bugun kechqurunga muhim insonimni olib kelaman.
cards.uzDef: Hayotingizdagi eng yaqin, muhim odam, ko'pincha romantik sherik.

cards.ex: The hospital needs to contact his next of kin.
cards.exUz: Kasalxona uning eng yaqin qarindoshiga bog'lanishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qon bo'yicha eng yaqin qarindosh, merosxo'r bo'lishi mumkin.

cards.ex: They decided to get hitched in Vegas.
cards.exUz: Ular Vegasda turmush qurishga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Turmush qurmoq, nikohdan o'tmoq (ko'pincha norasmiy)

cards.ex: There's a strong family resemblance between the siblings.
cards.exUz: Aka-ukalar o'rtasida kuchli oilaviy o'xshashlik bor.
cards.uzDef: Oila a'zolarining tashqi ko'rinishidagi o'xshashlik.

cards.ex: My brother and I are always on the same wavelength.
cards.exUz: Men va akam doim bir xil fikrdamiz.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil fikrda bo'lish, bir-birini tushunish.

cards.ex: He's a chip off the old block; he loves to build things just like his dad.
cards.exUz: U otasiga o'xshagan; u otasi kabi narsalar yasashni yaxshi ko'radi.
cards.term: a chip off the old block
cards.uzDef: Otasiga (yoki onasiga) xarakteri yoki odatlari bilan o'xshash bola.

cards.ex: Every relationship has its ups and downs.
cards.exUz: Har bir munosabatning ko'tarilish va pasayishlari bor.
cards.uzDef: Hayotning yaxshi va yomon davrlari.

cards.ex: He turned out to be a fair-weather friend when I needed him most.
cards.exUz: U menga eng kerak bo'lganida yaxshi kun do'sti bo'lib chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Faqat yaxshi kunlarda do'st bo'ladigan odam.

cards.ex: She's not an adopted child; she's a blood relative.
cards.exUz: U asrab olingan bola emas; u qon qarindoshi.
cards.uzDef: Qon bo'yicha qarindosh bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: We're having a big family gathering for Thanksgiving.
cards.exUz: Biz Shukrona kuni uchun katta oilaviy yig'ilish o'tkazyapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Oila a'zolarining birga yig'ilishi.

cards.ex: All my children have left the nest now.
cards.exUz: Endi barcha bolalarim uyidan ketishdi.
cards.uzDef: Ota-onasining uyini tark etmoq, mustaqil hayot boshlamoq.

cards.ex: I've always had a soft spot for my younger brother.
cards.exUz: Men har doim ukamga mehr qo'yganman.
cards.uzDef: Kimgadir yoki nimagadir nisbatan maxsus mehrga ega bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: We struck up a friendship while traveling in Europe.
cards.exUz: Biz Yevropada sayohat qilayotganda do'stlashib qoldik.
cards.uzDef: Yangi do'stlik boshlamoq.

cards.ex: She's always been a shoulder to cry on for me.
cards.exUz: U har doim men uchun dardkash do'st bo'lib kelgan.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin paytlarda yordam beradigan va tasalli beradigan odam.

cards.ex: After many years together, they decided to go their separate ways.
cards.exUz: Ko'p yillar birga bo'lganidan so'ng, ular o'z yo'llaridan ketishga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Munosabatlarni tugatmoq va boshqa yo'llardan ketmoq.

cards.ex: My parents instilled strong family values in me.
cards.exUz: Ota-onam menga kuchli oila qadriyatlarini singdirishdi.
cards.uzDef: Oilaning muhim deb hisoblagan axloqiy tamoyillari.

cards.ex: We had a fight, but we're back on speaking terms now.
cards.exUz: Biz urishib qoldik, lekin hozir yana gaplashadigan ahvoldamiz.
cards.uzDef: Biri bilan gaplashadigan darajada bo'lish.

cards.ex: They are doting parents and always put their children first.
cards.exUz: Ular mehribon ota-onalar va har doim bolalarini birinchi o'ringa qo'yishadi.
cards.uzDef: Bolalarini juda yaxshi ko'radigan va ularga g'amxo'rlik qiladigan ota-onalar.

cards.ex: They share a close bond and support each other unconditionally.
cards.exUz: Ular yaqin aloqaga ega va bir-birlarini hech qanday shartsiz qo'llab-quvvatlashadi.
cards.uzDef: Kuchli va yaqin munosabatlar.

cards.ex: She decided to fly the coop and travel the world.
cards.exUz: U qochib ketishga va dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: To'satdan va ruxsatsiz ketib qolmoq (ko'pincha uyidan).

cards.ex: I know he made mistakes, but blood runs thicker than water, so I'll always support him.
cards.exUz: Bilaman, u xato qildi, lekin qon suvdan qalinroq, shuning uchun men uni har doim qo'llab-quvvatlayman.
cards.uzDef: Oila a'zolarining munosabatlari boshqalardan muhimroq.

cards.ex: Some movies are rated PG for parental guidance.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi filmlar ota-ona maslahati uchun PG reytingiga ega.
cards.uzDef: Ota-onalarning bolalariga beradigan yo'l-yo'riqlari va maslahatlari.

cards.ex: We're researching our family tree to learn more about our ancestors.
cards.exUz: Biz ajdodlarimiz haqida ko'proq bilish uchun oila shajaramizni o'rganmoqdamiz.
cards.uzDef: Oila a'zolarining genealogik diagrammasi.

cards.ex: The family stood shoulder to shoulder during the crisis.
cards.exUz: Oila inqiroz davrida yelkama-yelka turdi.
cards.uzDef: Birgalikda, yonma-yon turib qo'llab-quvvatlash.

cards.ex: We need to build bridges with our neighbors after the argument.
cards.exUz: Biz bahsdan so'ng qo'shnilarimiz bilan ko'priklar qurishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Ajdolashgan munosabatlarni tiklamoq, aloqalarni mustahkamlamoq.

cards.ex: She's a bit of a mother hen when it comes to her children.
cards.exUz: U bolalari haqida gap ketganda, biroz g'amxo'r ona.
cards.uzDef: Haddan tashqari g'amxo'r va himoyachi ona.

cards.ex: After traveling for years, they decided to put down roots in Italy.
cards.exUz: Ko'p yillar sayohat qilgandan so'ng, ular Italiyada o'rnashib qolishga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Bir joyda yashashni boshlamoq va u yerda hayot qurmoq.

cards.ex: We had a heart-to-heart talk about our relationship.
cards.exUz: Biz munosabatlarimiz haqida dildan suhbatlashdik.
cards.uzDef: Chuqur va samimiy suhbat.

cards.ex: They got along like a house on fire when they first met.
cards.exUz: Ular birinchi marta uchrashganda tez do'stlashib ketishdi.
cards.uzDef: Tez va oson do'stlashmoq, yaxshi munosabatda bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: They've been thick as thieves since they were kids.
cards.exUz: Ular bolaligidan beri juda yaqin do'stlar.
cards.uzDef: Juda yaqin do'stlar, doimo birga bo'ladiganlar.
